title: Quality Gates Inventory
description: Schema for the inventory of quality gates. Each gate declares the single quality attribute it serves. Cross-references against the catalog (attributeId exists, catalogTests are drawn from that attribute's tests) are checked by validate-gates.mjs, which JSON Schema cannot express on its own.

strongCoverageMinRatio.description: Fraction of an attribute's catalog tests that its gates must implement for the attribute to count as covered rather than weakly covered.

id.description: Stable machine identifier, used as the gateId in evidence bundles.

attributeId.description: The single quality attribute this gate serves. Must be an id present in quality-attributes.json.

catalogTests.description: Which of the attribute's catalog tests this gate actually implements. May be empty: a gate can guard an attribute without implementing any named catalog test, and recording that honestly is what makes an attribute show up as weakly covered.

blocking.description: Whether a failure of this gate blocks deployment.

source.description: Where this gate's evidence comes from.

include.description: Test file globs, relative to the frontend directory. Vitest gate globs must partition the suite: every file belongs to exactly one gate.

requires.description: External prerequisites. A gate whose prerequisites are unavailable is reported as skipped, not failed.
